procedure_name: Vintage Motor Vehicle Special Registration (50+ Years)
summary: Special heritage registration series (e.g. 'VA') for preserved vintage cars and two-wheelers older than 50 years.

steps.title: Verify age of vehicle (50+ years)
steps.description: Vehicle must be in original authentic condition with no substantial overhaul of chassis or body shell.

steps.title: Submit Form 20A application
steps.description: Apply online under Vintage Motor Vehicle category on Parivahan Vahan.
documents_needed: Photographs of vintage car from all sides

steps.title: Inspection by Vintage Vehicle Committee
steps.description: Expert technical committee inspects preservation standards and mechanical safety.

steps.title: Allocation of Vintage Number Plate (VA series)
steps.description: Receive unique 10-character registration code (e.g. XX VA YY ****).
